Kuḍakācārya
--Samanvayapradīpa. gr. Alph. List Beng. Govt. p. 125 [no. 1555]. Author mentioned a. Kūḍaka an. his work Samanvaya-dik. in prose by Devaśarman in his Samanvayapradīpasaṅketa, a metrical recast of Kūḍaka's work. See BORI. D. II. i. 353.

Kūḍalisaṅgameśvarasvāmitaraṅga
by Veṅkaṭācala kavi, Parimi. Pt.. in a collection of stotras of the a. Guntur, 1922. See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1906-28. 1206.
